functional_requirements: Two Ø6 mm clearance through holes on the long (base) arm for M6 or 1/4-inch fasteners; hole centres 15 mm from each free end, i.e. 50 mm apart.
Base plate lies flat on the mounting surface (Z=0 face) and transfers load into the substrate through the two bolts.
Vertical arm provides a 60 mm standoff / mounting face for a secondary component.
Bracket must be rigid in bending about the Y axis; the 8 mm constant wall thickness and the sharp inner corner provide the L-stiffness (no gusset requested).
Holes must be clear of the vertical arm by at least 3 mm of material so bolt heads/washers seat flat on the base plate.
Printability: 3D-printable FDM part, flat base on the build plate, no support material required.
Part expected to be roughly 80 x 8 x 60 mm, suitable for light-to-medium duty brackets.
special_features: The two Ø6 mm through holes MUST be centred at X = HOLE_POS_X_2 = +25.0 and X = HOLE_POS_X_1 = -25.0 (HOLE_OFFSET_FROM_END = 15 mm from each of the X_MIN = -40 and X_MAX = +40 ends), giving HOLE_SPACING = 50 mm — they MUST NOT both be measured from the same end.

Both through holes MUST penetrate the base plate along the Z axis (its 8 mm PLATE_THICKNESS), i.e. sketch circles on the XY base plane and extrude/cut in Z; they MUST NOT be drilled along X or along Y.

The vertical arm MUST rise from the base plate at the +X end only, occupying X from VERTICAL_WALL_X_MIN = 32.0 to VERTICAL_WALL_X_MAX = 40.0 and Z from 0.0 to 60.0; it MUST NOT be placed at the -X end or at mid-span.
The vertical arm and the base plate MUST share a solid joint at X = 32.0..40.0, Z = 0.0..8.0 with no gap or thin tangency, so the result is one fused L-shaped body.
The base plate MUST be symmetric about the YZ plane (X = 0) with the two holes mirroring each other, while the vertical arm is located only at the +X end.
All features (base plate, vertical arm, holes) MUST be symmetric about the XZ plane (Y = 0); no feature may be offset in Y since the part is only ARM_DEPTH_Y = 8 mm deep.

The hole at X = +25.0 MUST keep at least HOLE_EDGE_TO_WALL_CLEARANCE = 4 mm of material to VERTICAL_ARM_INNER_FACE_X = 32.0, and both holes MUST keep at least 12 mm of material to the free end faces at X = ±40.
The L-bracket MUST have a constant wall thickness of PLATE_THICKNESS = 8 mm on both arms — no ribs, gussets, chamfers, fillets or lightening cutouts are to be added.

The outer corner of the L (at X = 40.0, Z = 60.0 region) MUST remain a sharp 90-degree right angle formed by the outer faces of the two arms; the inner corner at X = 32.0, Z = 8.0 MUST be a sharp 90-degree inside corner.
The finished solid MUST be watertight with exactly two cylindrical through-hole walls of diameter HOLE_DIAMETER = 6.0 mm, and MUST NOT contain any blind, partial or capped holes.
